description: Keep the 25/75 throughput-Jain reward fixed and test whether reducing Beta sampling noise over training improves the deterministic mean-policy.

cases.label: 25% throughput + 75% Jain; learned Beta concentration near 20
cases.hypothesis: Reproduce the current train-deployment mismatch under the same source version and evaluator.

cases.label: 25% throughput + 75% Jain; Beta concentration 20 to 80
cases.hypothesis: Moderately reduce action noise so the mean priority policy must learn UE rotation.

cases.label: 25% throughput + 75% Jain; Beta concentration 20 to 200
cases.hypothesis: Strong late-stage alignment to deterministic actions may remove the stochastic fairness illusion, but could reduce exploration too quickly.
